exposure: laparoscopic salpingectomy or salpingostomy (as surgical procedure)
cohort: A sample of 866 women who underwent various gynecological laparoscopic procedures for different indications at two tertiary referral hospitals in Jordan.
finding: The overall prevalence of endometriosis was 10.3% among women undergoing gynecological laparoscopy, and it was found to be associated with higher age, lower BMI, lower parity, and fewer cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Endometriosis was significantly less prevalent in patients with fewer cesarean sections (OR 0.53).
